Name: Lovely Kitchen Islands and Extras (AT)
Author: lululovely
Description:
The Lovely Kitchen needed a Lovely Kitchen Island! ﻿Includes two sizes and many colors, plus a matching coffee machine, telephone, and freestanding kitchen cabinets.

You can also add the optional separate mod [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8123]Lovely Kitchen[/url]﻿[/b] for coordinating kitchens, with various cabinet, counter, handle, and appliance colors to choose from.

= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =

* * *   REQUIREMENTS   * * *
SMAPI
Alternative Textures

= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =

* * *   INSTRUCTIONS   * * *

- Install the latest versions of SMAPI and Alternative Textures.
- Download this mod, unzip it, and place the "[AT]Lovely Kitchen Islands and Extras" folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.
- Buy a Paint Bucket from Robin to select new colors and textures!

= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =

* * *   CONFIGURATION OPTIONS   * * *

*  MODERN END TABLE  *
Freestanding Individual Cabinets18 colors with 3 countertop colors each

*  MODERN TABLE  *
Small kitchen island18 colors with 3 countertop colors each

*  MODERN DINING TABLE  *
Large kitchen island, can be turned horizontally or vertically18 colors with 3 countertop colors each

*  MODERN BOOKCASE  *
Matching 2-tile wide tall cabinet18 colors

*  CHINA CABINET  *
Matching 3-tile wide tall cabinet18 colors

*  COFFEE MAKER  *
Incorporate the coffee maker to look like part of your kitchen18 colors with 3 countertop colors eachAlso includes the kitchen cart design from Lovely Coffee Maker

*  TELEPHONE  *
Incorporate the telephone to look like part of your kitchen18 colors with 3 countertop colors each

*  DRIED SUNFLOWERS  *
The large kitchen island has a vase of flowers on top. Use this to add a matching small or large version of these flowers elsewhere.

= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =

*  L O V E L Y   K I T C H E N  *
*  OPTIONAL  *
You can add matching kitchens! [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8123]Lovely Kitchen[/url]﻿[/b] is a separate mod that works with Content Patcher.
